quote: You sit alone in the quiet dark, wondering where the warmth went. The shadows stretch long across your empty floor, whispering secrets of forgotten yesterdays. Every memory feels like a sharp glass shard, cutting deep into your fragile chest. You hold your breath to stop the shaking, praying for a merciful dawn. Pain is simply the price of having loved so fiercely. Let the grief wash entirely over your tired soul.
